description: Overly Permissive IAM Roles Task roles are configured with broad permissions (e.g., 'rds:DescribeDBInstances' on '*') instead of being scoped to specific resources. This violates the principle of least privilege. An attacker who compromises a container could leverage the overly permissive task role to access or modify resources outside the intended scope.
references: recommendation: Implement least privilege IAM policies for ECS tasks

description: Insecure Data Transmission Traffic between services and the ALB is not encrypted by default. The CDK code shows HTTP listener configuration without TLS. An attacker with network access could intercept sensitive data transmitted between microservices or from clients to the ALB.
references: recommendation: Enable TLS for all service communications
